# Parcel API

Processes parcel status events for internal development.

Run `make serve` from the repository root.

The API prints `listening on :8080` when it is ready.

## Architecture

See [the event flow](docs/architecture.md).

files.scripts/generate_config_docs.py:
import json
from pathlib import Path

schema = json.loads(Path('config/schema.json').read_text())
lines = ['<!-- Generated by make docs-config. Do not edit manually. -->', '# Configuration', '', '| Name | Default |', '| --- | --- |']
for name, spec in schema['properties'].items():
    lines.append(f"| `{name}` | `{spec['default']}` |")
Path('docs/reference/configuration.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
